pairs.target: mǐlā qiányìwǎn lái wèn guò liǎng rén de kòngxián , dìèrtiān xiàwǔ , tǎ wéi biàn tóng yīwén qù le mùgōng fáng , ménbiān liàngzhe yíkuài shībù , zhuōshàng nà zhī jiù kuàng yě shī zhe .
pairs.english: Mira had come to ask when both were free the previous evening; the next afternoon Tavi then went with Iven to the woodshop, where a wet cloth hung by the door and the old frame on the table was wet too.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉前一晚来问过两人的空闲，第二天下午，塔维便同伊文去了木工房，门边晾着一块湿布，桌上那只旧框也湿着。

pairs.target: tā jiāng kuàng pào guò yíyè , mùsè shēn le yìcéng , quēkǒu hái zài , shì tiáo què bǐ gān de shíhòu gèng nán wǎng wài zǒu , yīwén kànjiàn biàn xiān bǎ xiùzi wǎnqǐ .
pairs.english: She had soaked the frame overnight, deepening its wood color a shade; the notch remained, but the test strip was harder to draw out than when dry; seeing this, Iven first rolled his sleeves up.
pairs.hanzi: 她将框泡过一夜，木色深了一层，缺口还在，试条却比干的时候更难往外走，伊文看见便先把袖子挽起。

pairs.target: " xiān bié ná . "
pairs.english: “Do not pick it up yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “先别拿。”

pairs.target: mǐlā yòng tàn tóu zài kuàngshàng huà le yì héng , shuō zuórì shì guò , kào shǐjìn bá néng chūlái , kě yòubiān huì dài xià yìxiǎopiàn mùtou , nà búsuàn chāi hǎo le .
pairs.english: Mira drew a horizontal mark on the frame with charcoal, saying she had tried yesterday: with a hard pull it could come out, but would tear a small sliver of wood from the right side, and that did not count as proper disassembly.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉用炭头在框上画了一横，说昨日试过，靠使劲拔能出来，可右边会带下一小片木头，那不算拆好了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kàn jiù hén , cái kànjiàn pángbiān duō le gè néng xiè de mù jiǎo , tā méiyǒu zài bǎ quēkǒu xiāo dà , ér bǎ dǎng zhe shì tiáo de yìbiān lìng zuòchéng néng tuì kāi de .
pairs.english: Tavi bent to examine the old marks and only then noticed a removable wooden corner had appeared beside them; she had not enlarged the notch again, but separately made the side blocking the test strip able to slide away.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头看旧痕，才看见旁边多了个能卸的木角，她没有再把缺口削大，而把挡着试条的一边另做成能退开的。

pairs.target: tā xiān qǔ xiàyā zài kuàngshàng de xiǎo shādài , fàngdào zhuōshàng , cái tuìchū mù jiǎo , nuókāi cè tiáo , jiù shì tiáo zhōngyú néng cóng pángbiān táichūlái .
pairs.english: She first removed the small sandbag pressing on the frame and set it on the table; only then did she withdraw the wooden corner and move the side strip, finally able to lift the old test strip out sideways.
pairs.hanzi: 她先取下压在框上的小沙袋，放到桌上，才退出木角、挪开侧条，旧试条终于能从旁边抬出来。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō zhèhuí méiyǒu guā mùxiè , tā shuō zhèhuí shì , què bùkěn bǎ pào guò yíyè děngtóngyú néng lín zhěngjì de yǔ , mù jiǎo shàigān hòu háiyào chóngxīn shì .
pairs.english: Iven said it had not produced shavings this time; she said yes, this time, but would not equate one night's soaking with surviving a whole season's rain; after the wooden corner dried in the sun they would have to test again.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说这回没有刮木屑，她说这回是，却不肯把泡过一夜等同于能淋整季的雨，木角晒干后还要重新试。

pairs.target: " nǐ ràng wǒ bāng zhe kàn nǎér ? "
pairs.english: “Where do you want me to help look?”
pairs.hanzi: “你让我帮着看哪儿？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问。

pairs.target: " bié zhào wǒ de shǒufǎ zhuāng huíqù , wǒ tài zhīdào zěnme hǒng tā le . "
pairs.english: “Do not put it back using my method; I know far too well how to coax it.”
pairs.hanzi: “别照我的手法装回去，我太知道怎么哄它了。”

pairs.target: yīwén xiān zhuāng , cè tiáo fǎn le yìbiān , mǐlā zhāngzuǐ yàoshuō , yòu bì shàng , děng tā zìjǐ fāxiàn shì tiáo xuán zhe , cái wèn nǎ zhāng tú méi huà míngbái .
pairs.english: Iven assembled first, reversing the side strip; Mira opened her mouth to speak, then closed it again, waiting for him himself to notice the test strip hanging loose before asking which drawing was unclear.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文先装，侧条反了一边，米拉张嘴要说，又闭上，等他自己发现试条悬着，才问哪张图没画明白。

pairs.target: tā zhǐzhe zhǐ shàng de xiéxiàn , shuō hái yǐwéi nà shì tā huàdiào búyào de , mǐlā bǎ zhǐ zhuǎnguò lái , zìjǐ kàn le yízhèn , ná tàn tóu jiāng nà yíchù quānzhù .
pairs.english: He pointed at the diagonal on the paper, saying he had thought she had crossed it out as unwanted; Mira turned the paper around, looked a while herself, and circled that spot with charcoal.
pairs.hanzi: 他指着纸上的斜线，说还以为那是她划掉不要的，米拉把纸转过来，自己看了一阵，拿炭头将那一处圈住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dìèrgè zhuāng , méiyǒu fǎn , què bǎ mù jiǎo tuī de tài shēn , zài chāi shí děi liǎngzhīshǒu yìqǐ nuó , děng dōngxī dōu fàngwěn , cái yǒu yúlì xiào yīwén .
pairs.english: Tavi assembled second without reversing it, but pushed the wooden corner too deep; when taking it apart again he needed both hands to move it together; he waited until all the pieces were settled before he had energy left to laugh at Iven.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维第二个装，没有反，却把木角推得太深，再拆时得两只手一起挪，等东西都放稳，才有余力笑伊文。

pairs.target: " nǐ fāngcái yě méi kuài dào nǎér qù . "
pairs.english: “You were not exactly fast just now either.”
pairs.hanzi: “你方才也没快到哪儿去。”

pairs.target: yīwén ná gānbù cādiào zhǐbiān de shuǐ , shuō qīng wěi nà yìtiáo yǐ tiān huí jiùfù de zhàng , liǎnggè rén míng méi zài túchéng liǎngtiáochuán , jiùfù hái jiào tā bǎ lìng yíyè yě qù wèn wán .
pairs.english: Iven wiped water from the paper's edge with a dry cloth, saying Green Tail's entry had been added back to his uncle's accounts, without the two people's names becoming two boats again; his uncle had also told him to finish asking about another page.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文拿干布擦掉纸边的水，说青尾那一条已添回舅父的账，两个人名没再涂成两条船，舅父还叫他把另一页也去问完。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō zhè cái xiàng zuòdehǎo de xiàchǎng , tā shuō tā búbì tì zhǎngbèi gāoxìng , zìjǐ zhǐshì zhōngyú búyòng ná dàokòu de xié dāng chuánpéng gěi rén kàn .
pairs.english: Mira said that sounded like the consequences of doing well; he said she need not be pleased for their elders, he was merely finally spared showing people an upside-down shoe as a boat canopy.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说这才像做得好的下场，他说她不必替长辈高兴，自己只是终于不用拿倒扣的鞋当船篷给人看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào wán , jiǎng qǐ zhuōshàng nà kuài xiàng dùn de mù tuō , shuō tā zhǐ duō tuì le yìdiǎn , sòng yuǎn wèn tā shìbushì hái xiánxiǎo , tā rújīn bù zhīdào gāi zěnme dá .
pairs.english: After laughing, Tavi described the shieldlike wooden carrier on the table, saying it had yielded only a little farther; Song Yuan had asked whether he still thought it small, and now he did not know how to answer.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑完，讲起桌上那块像盾的木托，说它只多退了一点，宋远问他是不是还嫌小，他如今不知道该怎么答。

pairs.target: mǐlā méi shuō xiǎo yě yǒuyòng , fǎnér zhuīwèn mùbǎn kào nǎ yíduàn dàidòng tiě wān , tīng wán biàn ná liǎnggēn duǎn mùtiáo bǎi le bǎi , ràng tā zhǐ shǒuzhǎng fàng de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Mira did not say small was useful too, instead asking which section of the board moved the iron into bending; after hearing, she took two short wooden strips and arranged them, having him point where his palms were placed.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没说小也有用，反而追问木板靠哪一段带动铁弯，听完便拿两根短木条摆了摆，让他指手掌放的位置。

pairs.target: tā zhào jìyì bǐ guòqù , tā bǎ yìgēn nuókāi , shuō zìjǐ yě xiǎng kànkàn shíwù , zhèngyào zài wèn , ménwài de lǎoshī jiào tā guòqù , dàishàng nà zhāng xiūgǎi de tú .
pairs.english: He indicated it from memory; she moved one strip away and said she too wanted to see the actual object; just as she was about to ask more, the instructor outside called her over with the revised drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 他照记忆比过去，她把一根挪开，说自己也想看看实物，正要再问，门外的老师叫她过去，带上那张修改的图。

pairs.target: tā huílái shí bǎ zhǐ yā zài kuàngxià , shuō xiàgèyuè yǒu yìhuí dài xuéshēng qù kàn yǔ hòu de shì jià , lǎoshī wèn tā yuànbuyuànyì bǎ chāixiè zhèbùfen yě ná qù shì .
pairs.english: When she returned she weighted the paper under the frame, saying next month there would be one student visit to see the test frames after rain; the instructor had asked if she was willing to try the disassembly part there too.
pairs.hanzi: 她回来时把纸压在框下，说下个月有一回带学生去看雨后的试架，老师问她愿不愿意把拆卸这部分也拿去试。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān wèn dào nǎlǐ , tā shuō chéngwài de jiù shìchǎng , rìzi háiyào děng tiān , yě méi shuō dìng dài shuí , tā què yòu wèn , shìbushì fēiqùbùkě .
pairs.english: Tavi first asked where; she said the old testing ground outside the city, its date still depending on the weather and no students chosen yet; nevertheless he asked again whether going was necessary.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先问到哪里，她说城外的旧试场，日子还要等天，也没说定带谁，他却又问，是不是非去不可。

pairs.target: mǐlā de shǒu tíng zài kuàngshàng , wūlǐ mù bào tuīguòqù yìshēng , tā guò le yízhèn cái shuō , zìjǐ běnlái biànshì xiǎng zuò néng fàngdào lùshang de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Mira's hand stopped on the frame; a plane rasped across wood in the room, and after a while only then she said she had always wanted to make things that could actually go on roads.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉的手停在框上，屋里木刨推过去一声，她过了一阵才说，自己本来便是想做能放到路上的东西。

pairs.target: " wǒ búshì shuō nǐ bùnéng qù . "
pairs.english: “I am not saying you cannot go.”
pairs.hanzi: “我不是说你不能去。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào , kě nǐ zhè jù tīng zhe , hǎoxiàng wǒ zhǐyào shuō bú qù , nǐ jiù néng sōngkǒuqì . "
pairs.english: “I know, but the way you say that sounds as though you could relax if I just said I would not go.”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道，可你这句听着，好像我只要说不去，你就能松口气。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi néng jiēshàng , yīwén méiyǒu tì shuí dǎyuánchǎng , bǎ shībù cóng tú biān līn kāi , shuō zhèkuài hái shī zhe , bié yòu ná tā cā zhuō .
pairs.english: Tavi could not reply; Iven did not smooth things over for either of them, lifting the wet cloth from the drawing's edge and saying this one was still wet, so do not wipe the table with it again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没能接上，伊文没有替谁打圆场，把湿布从图边拎开，说这块还湿着，别又拿它擦桌。

pairs.target: zhèhuà shuō de bú dà hé shí , sāngè rén què dōu dītóu qù kàn , shuǐ yǐjīng zhān dào mǐlā quān de nà yídào , tànhēi sànkāi , tā máng bǎ gānbù diàn dào xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: The remark was not very timely, yet all three bent to look; water had already reached the line Mira had circled and the charcoal black spread, so she hurried to slip a dry cloth underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 这话说得不大合时，三个人却都低头去看，水已经沾到米拉圈的那一道，炭黑散开，她忙把干布垫到下面。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì tā ànzhù lìng yìjiǎo , zhèhuí méiyǒu bǎ xiǎng shuō dehuà yě gǎnzhe àn xiàqù , děng tā jiāng tú tái lí shī chù , cái shuō zìjǐ tīngjiàn chéngwài biàn xiān xiǎngdào shàng huí .
pairs.english: Tavi held another corner for her, this time not also rushing to press down his unspoken words; once she lifted the drawing clear of the damp spot, he said that hearing outside the city made him first think of last time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替她按住另一角，这回没有把想说的话也赶着按下去，等她将图抬离湿处，才说自己听见城外便先想到上回。

pairs.target: mǐlā kànzhe tā yòushǒu , shēngyīn dī xiàlái , shuō tā yě huì xiǎngdào , dàn ruò yīncǐ lián shìchǎng dōu bùkěn qù , wǎnghòu yào zuò shénme , tā yě bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: Mira looked at his right hand, her voice lowering, and said she thought of it too, but if that meant refusing even to go to the test ground, she did not know what she would do in future either.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看着他右手，声音低下来，说她也会想到，但若因此连试场都不肯去，往后要做什么，她也不知道。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu dāying péi tā qù , gèng méiyǒu shuō zìjǐ hěnkuài jiù néng hù zhe tā , zhǐ wèn nà zhāng tú yào buyào xiànzài zài chāo yífèn , miǎnde nà yíchù yòu chéng le kànbùdǒng de xiéxiàn .
pairs.english: He did not promise to accompany her, much less say he would soon be able to protect her, only asking whether the drawing should be copied once more now, lest that spot become an unreadable diagonal again.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有答应陪她去，更没有说自己很快就能护着她，只问那张图要不要现在再抄一份，免得那一处又成了看不懂的斜线。

pairs.target: tā shuō yào , yīwén bǎ gān zhǐ tuīguòlái , zìjǐ xiān zài jiǎo shàng huà le zhī dàokòu de xié , mǐlā mà tā , tā xiào zhe ná bù qù cā , xiǎnxiē yòu ná chéng shī de .
pairs.english: She said yes; Iven pushed the dry paper over and first drew an upside-down shoe in its corner himself; Mira scolded him, and he laughed, taking a cloth to wipe it, almost choosing the wet one again.
pairs.hanzi: 她说要，伊文把干纸推过来，自己先在角上画了只倒扣的鞋，米拉骂他，他笑着拿布去擦，险些又拿成湿的。

pairs.target: tiānsè àn xiàlái shí , mù jiǎo yǐjīng chāi le fàngzài gān chù , shì tiáo hái tǎng zài zhuōbiān , tǎ wéi tì mǐlā liúchū huà cè tiáo de wèizhì , tā huà de xiǎo mù tuō zhǐ zhàn le zhǐbèi yìjiǎo .
pairs.english: As daylight faded, the wooden corner had been removed and put somewhere dry, the test strip still lying at the table's edge; Tavi left room for Mira to draw the side strip, his little carrier drawing occupying only a corner on the paper's back.
pairs.hanzi: 天色暗下来时，木角已经拆了放在干处，试条还躺在桌边，塔维替米拉留出画侧条的位置，他画的小木托只占了纸背一角。
